toolchain: TextMate upstream settings parser, upstream glob conversion and Oniguruma
reproduction_command: g++ <TextMate parser.cc, parse_glob.cc and parser_base.cc> lookup.cc -lonig; ./lookup
semantic_scope: The upstream settings parser read the unchanged properties file and its glob converter selected which synthetic filename receives the GREETING property. The positive TXT lookup returned the exact greeting and the Markdown control had no value.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
